quotes.text: Bug 1895002 says tb-rust notifications never worked correctly. The first fix was backed out for task decision failures; Bugzilla explains the separate syntax: a route such as notify.matrix-room.<room>.on-any triggers task-state notices, while notify:matrix-room:<room> authorizes direct Notify API calls. A granted scope with an extra dot did not cover both forms. D209693 author called out the significance of colons versus dots; reviewer requested formatting fixes after Try, then accepted. The relanded comm patch resolves routes and scopes by level, choosing Matrix for level 3 and owner email otherwise. Current config uses on-defined/on-resolved routes, so the exact event suffix changed later. When editing Taskcluster notification config, validate route names, scope grants, and generated tasks together.
